benefit.name: Community Pass — OC Transpo discount for ODSP recipients (Ottawa)
benefit.summary: A discounted OC Transpo pass for Ottawa residents who get ODSP. It covers every route, including Para Transpo, with no top-up charge. The Access pass costs the same but does not include this.
benefit.note: Community and Access passes both cost $43.25 a month, but Access holders pay a $2.75 top-up for every Para Transpo ride while the Community Pass includes Para Transpo with no top-up. If you receive ODSP and use Para Transpo, the Community Pass is the cheaper of the two. The rural fare is not included in either.

items: You receive benefits under the Ontario Disability Support Program
eligibility.note: To prove it you need your ODSP number — the 9-digit identification number on an ODSP document — together with a Presto card number or a Para Transpo ID number. Discounted fares cannot be used when paying cash; you need a Presto card.

detail.about: The Community Pass is OC Transpo's discounted fare for Ottawa residents who receive ODSP benefits. It costs $43.25 a month, or $1.75 per ride, and lets you ride on all routes including Para Transpo without paying a top-up. The rural fare is not included.

aboutList.lead: The Community Pass is OC Transpo's ODSP discount.
items: $43.25 for a monthly pass, or $1.75 per ride.
Valid on all routes, including Para Transpo, with no top-up charge.
The Para Transpo rural fare is not included.
You must use a Presto card — discounted fares are not available when paying cash.
For comparison, the regular adult fare is $4.10 a ride and $138.50 a month.

steps: Get your ODSP identification number from an ODSP document
Get a Presto card, or have your Para Transpo ID number to hand
Set the Community discount on your card at an OC Transpo Customer Service Centre, or by calling OC Transpo Customer Service — discounted monthly passes cannot be set anywhere else
Buy monthly passes up to 14 days before the month starts; a pass is valid only for the calendar month it is bought for
documents: Your 9-digit ODSP identification number from an ODSP document
A Presto card number, or a Para Transpo ID number
tips: If you use Para Transpo and get ODSP, choose the Community Pass over the Access pass. It is the same $43.25, but with no $2.75 Para Transpo top-up per ride.
You must set up discounted monthly passes at a Customer Service Centre or by phone, not at a store.
If verification is needed, a lawyer, notary, registered social worker, or a member of one of the regulated health colleges can act as a guarantor.

values.note: $43.25/month or $1.75/ride, all routes including Para Transpo with no top-up

meta.effort: Set the discount at a Customer Service Centre with your ODSP number and Presto card
